purpose: Public source statements captured for the November 2026 book session calendar (2026-10-29 to 2026-11-30) and provisional December 2026 holiday evidence. Text extracts only; each statement is quoted or transcribed from the rendered page, or from the JSON the CME trading-hours calendar widget loads, at the capture instant. extracted_text_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the capture's statements joined by newline (UTF-8); page_text_sha256 and response_sha256 hash the in-page text or the raw widget response where recorded. Capture ids reuse the authoring tool's fixed source ids. CME times are Central Time unless stated; matching_halts are converted to UTC (EST, UTC-5). CME holiday hours are provisional until about two weeks before each holiday. These establish source semantics for the forward file and are not exchange-closure facts for historical dates.
captured_by: in-app browser, read-only page loads and same-origin GETs of the calendar widget's data endpoint, 2026-10-03 UTC (2026-10-02 US)

statements: All positions must be closed by 4:45 PM Eastern Time each trading day. You cannot hold positions overnight or swing trade. This applies to ALL account types including Live.
Market opens: 6:00 PM Eastern Time (Sunday through Thursday). Market closes: 5:00 PM Eastern Time (Monday through Friday). Daily maintenance break: 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time.
Regular days: Close all positions by 4:45 PM ET. Holiday shortened days: Close all positions by 12:59 PM ET.
Important: Holiday market hours are announced in our Discord server. Check before trading on holidays.
A trading day at Tradeify spans from 6:00 PM ET to 5:00 PM ET the next calendar day.
Holiday trading days count as independent trading days, even with shortened hours

Rithmic accounts and holiday half-days: On the Rithmic broker, holiday half-day (shortened) sessions are recorded at the next full market close. The day still counts as a trading day, but the credit (and any payout based on it) may not post until the following full session closes.
Eastern Time (ET). This is Eastern Standard Time (EST) in winter and Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) in summer.
A trading day is counted as at least one trade placed from 6:00 P.M. EST/EDT to 5:00 P.M. EST/EDT the next day.

Rithmic accounts: On the Rithmic broker, a holiday half-day (shortened session) is not recorded until the next full market close. The day still counts as a trading day, but the credit (and any payout based on it) may not post until the following full session closes.
